concepts.proposed_markdown:
Under `## Platform-Specific Implementation`, add: `- **Braintree subscription management**: [[source-braintree-recurring-billing-manage-node]] routes status-qualified updates, mid-cycle proration and failed-proration behavior, past-due balance and retry handling, manual-retry settlement boundaries, and transaction-based refunds. Canceled and Expired subscriptions cannot be changed; Past Due updates are limited to non-price fields. A refund does not itself cancel future subscription billing.`

Under `## Sources`, add: `- [[source-braintree-recurring-billing-manage-node]] - Braintree Node.js subscription-management guide for status-dependent updates, proration, retry handling, settlement qualification and refunds`
warnings: Keep Past Due update scope limited to subscription ID, payment method, merchant account and descriptor; do not generalize it to every non-price field.
Preserve the default failed-proration behavior and the separately configurable continue-and-add-to-balance path.
Do not convert automatic retry timing or some-declines-not-retried wording into a success, cadence or eventual-collection guarantee.
Keep refund eligibility scoped to an existing Settled or Settling sale transaction, and keep cancellation as a separate action.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-recurring-billing-manage-node]] - Node.js subscription-management guide covering status-qualified updates, proration and failed-charge behavior, past-due retries, version-qualified retry settlement, and transaction-based refunds
warnings: The collected guide says `latest versions of our server SDKs` without naming a version; do not map the behavior to the retained `braintree@3.39.0` package baseline without separate evidence.
Authorization after a retry is not settlement completion; preserve the separate settlement-submission boundary.
Do not import routine request fields or worked examples into the concept; keep them behind the source and raw locators.
